component.name: RadioPod
component.summary: Privacy-first internet radio and podcast player

description.p: RadioPod plays internet radio and podcasts. Find stations in the community-run Radio-Browser database and podcasts in Podcast Index, group them into playlists, and listen — at your desk, on your phone, or in the car through Android Auto.

A podcast sits in your list beside the stations. Tap it to resume the episode you were part way through, or else start the newest. Each episode remembers where you stopped, so you can pick it up on another device, and you can skip back and forward or mark it played.

Your stations, podcasts, playlists and listening progress are stored encrypted in your personal online data store (Pod) within a Data Vault hosted by your Solid Server of choice, so nobody — not even the server administrator — can see what you listen to. Without a login the library is kept on this device instead and nothing is sent anywhere.
Playlists import and export as M3U and PLS, the open formats every other radio player reads. Podcasts import and export as OPML, so you can bring your subscriptions from another podcast app.
